info.title: MDK site launcher (Railway)
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 contract for http-mdk-launch, replacing the earlier OpenAPI 3/REST surface (see git history for openapi/launch.openapi.yaml) to match how the underlying MDK stack actually communicates. Single transport: POST /v1/rpc with a {jsonrpc:'2.0', method, params, id} body; responses are always HTTP 200 with either a result or a JSON-RPC error object in the body, per JSON-RPC-over-HTTP convention. Session auth is a cookie (see session.create/auth.createWallet), unaffected by this transport change. GET /health, GET /ready, GET /v1/sites/{id}/spec.yaml, and the page/asset routes are deliberately NOT part of this RPC surface: Railway's healthcheck needs a plain GET, and a YAML file download needs a real downloadable URL, not a POST envelope. Provenance honesty, method by method: auth.createWallet/session.create/session.logout/session.me are this launcher's own BIP-39/WDK-derived seed-phrase sign-in scheme (src/wdk.js, src/session.js) with no MDK-core counterpart -- WDK is a separate Tether product (the Wallet Development Kit), not MDK; sites.validate/sites.get/sites.stop/sites.notes.set are launcher-owned bookkeeping and validation with no MDK-core call of their own; sites.create/sites.overview/sites.reveal are mixed -- the RPC envelope, slot bookkeeping, and error-shaping are launcher-owned, while what they actually boot or probe (Kernel/Gateway/Worker boot via templates/minimal-site/start.js's getKernel()/kernel.registerWorker()/waitForDiscovery()/startGateway(), and the real Gateway GET /overview route) is genuine MDK 0.6 core. Every method and every components.schemas entry below carries its own x-provenance plus a [BYOT]/[MDK CORE]/[MIXED]-prefixed description spelling out the precise split.

methods.name: session.me
methods.description: [BYOT] Reports this launcher's own HMAC-signed session-cookie state (src/session.js's sessionFromRequest). MDK core has no session or identity-reporting capability of its own to wrap here.

methods.name: auth.createWallet
methods.summary: Create a new BIP-39 seed and sign in with it
methods.description: [BYOT] This launcher's own seed-phrase sign-in scheme: src/wdk.js generates a BIP-39 mnemonic (@scure/bip39) and derives a public key via @tetherto/wdk-wallet-solana -- WDK, the Wallet Development Kit, a different Tether product from MDK itself. MDK core has no wallet, session, or identity capability of its own being wrapped here (see maintainers/README.md's Stage 2 rewrite: a deliberate simplification of an even-more-BYOT original design). The seed phrase is returned exactly once in the result and never stored server-side beyond deriving the public key. Sets the session cookie.

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Sign in with an existing BIP-39 seed phrase
methods.description: [BYOT] Accepts a pasted BIP-39 seed phrase and derives its public key via src/wdk.js's publicKeyFromSeed (WDK's WalletManagerSolana, not an MDK capability), then sets this launcher's own session cookie (src/session.js's signSession). No MDK capability corresponds to this.

methods.name: session.logout
methods.description: [BYOT] Clears this launcher's own HMAC-signed session cookie (src/session.js's clearCookieHeader). No MDK-core equivalent exists.

methods.name: sites.validate
methods.summary: Validate a SiteLaunch document without launching it
methods.description: [BYOT] Runs this launcher's own AJV JSON-Schema validation (src/validate-site.js against src/schema/site-launch.json) over the SiteLaunch envelope. Performs no MDK call at all.

errors.message: Invalid or unsupported spec

methods.name: sites.create
methods.summary: Launch the minimal-site template into Site 1, 2, or 3
methods.description: [MIXED] The RPC envelope, slot bookkeeping (recordForSlot()/nextSlot() in src/server.js), and idempotency-shaped SiteRecord are this launcher's own invention; what it actually boots is real MDK 0.6 core -- templates/minimal-site/start.js's getKernel(), kernel.registerWorker(), waitForDiscovery(), and startGateway(). Session-gated. Boots Kernel, a demo Worker, and Gateway on loopback. Set metadata.slot (1/2/3) to target a tab explicitly, so Site 1 and Site 2 can run independently customized specs instead of relying on first-empty-slot assignment.

methods.description: [BYOT] Returns this launcher's own in-memory lifecycle bookkeeping (the sites Map in src/server.js) for one siteId; no MDK-core call of its own beyond what sites.create already performed at boot.

methods.name: sites.stop
methods.description: [BYOT] Launcher-owned lifecycle bookkeeping: stopSite()/stopChild() (src/server.js, src/supervisor.js) send SIGTERM (then SIGKILL if needed) to the supervised child process. No MDK-core call of its own beyond process signal handling.

methods.name: sites.overview
methods.summary: Live device overview from a site's Gateway
methods.description: [MIXED] Probes a real Gateway route, GET /overview -- MDK core's plugin-served HTTP surface (templates/minimal-site/plugins/dashboard/controllers/overview.js, backed by services.mdkClient.listWorkers()/pullTelemetry()); the RPC method wrapping, session gating, and error-shaping around that probe (src/server.js, src/supervisor.js's probeOverview()) are this launcher's own.

methods.name: sites.reveal
methods.summary: JSON reveal: launch curl, key fingerprints, storage-at-rest, live telemetry
methods.description: [MIXED] A composite result whose fields split independently -- see SiteReveal's own x-provenance and description for the field-by-field breakdown (requestCurl is byot; keys are real MDK-core key material in a byot fingerprint format; storage.corestore is a real MDK/Hypercore Corestore path inside an otherwise byot storage object; telemetry reuses sites.overview's real Gateway probe; telemetryStorage, when present, is entirely byot).

SessionInfo.description: [BYOT] Reports this launcher's own session-cookie state (src/session.js's sessionFromRequest); MDK core has no session or identity-reporting capability of its own.

SessionCreated.description: [BYOT] This launcher's own sign-in response shape, wrapping a BIP-39/WDK-derived public key (src/wdk.js) and this launcher's HMAC-signed session token (src/session.js's signSession); not an MDK-defined contract.

seedPhrase.description: Present only when created=true. Shown once.

SiteLaunch.description: [MIXED] The envelope -- apiVersion/kind/metadata -- is a launcher-owned namespace (launch.mdk.tether.io/v1alpha1; see maintainers/README.md Stage 3: 'a launcher-owned namespace,' not a native MDK config file, since public 0.6 has no mdk.yaml stack document for this topology). spec.template selects a real MDK-core template (Kernel/Gateway/Worker boot per templates/minimal-site/start.js) and spec.persistence controls whether that boot's Kernel root lands on a Railway volume.

slot.description: Target Site 1, 2, or 3 explicitly instead of first-empty-slot assignment.

username.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for this site's protected Gateway routes.

password.description: Plaintext password, submitted once. The launcher hashes it immediately on receipt (scrypt, random per-site salt) and discards the plaintext: never stored in the SiteRecord, never included in sites.reveal or the downloadable spec.yaml, and never passed to the child process -- only the salt+hash are, via env vars.

SiteLaunchSpecAuth.description: [BYOT] The basic-auth plugin and this schema are this launcher's own invention, not an MDK-provided plugin (see templates/minimal-site/plugins/basic-auth/lib/guard.js's requireBasicAuth and design/plugin-basic-auth.md). Confirmed further by src/supervisor.js's INTERNAL_PROBE_SECRET: this launcher had to invent its own internal-probe header specifically because MDK core has no concept of "this HTTP call is the platform's own health check, not a user request." Optional. Omitting this object entirely means the site has no basic-auth protection (default, unchanged). Its presence is itself the opt-in.

PluginName.description: [BYOT] telemetry-store is this launcher's own plugin invention (templates/minimal-site/plugins/telemetry-store), with no MDK-provided telemetry-persistence mechanism behind it. Closed set of config-free plugins a site can opt into via spec.plugins. basic-auth is not in this enum because it always needs config and is opted into via spec.auth's presence instead.

SiteLaunchSpecPlugins.description: [BYOT] This array and every plugin it can name are this launcher's own opt-in mechanism; MDK core provides the underlying Gateway plugin-loading mechanism (extraPluginDirs) but not this specific plugin roster. Optional. Omit (or []) for default behavior: no extra plugins. Listing 'telemetry-store' boots the site with the telemetry-store plugin registered, appending every polled telemetry read to an on-disk CSV under the site's .mdk-data root.

SiteRecord.description: [MIXED] The lifecycle envelope -- siteId, slot, state machine, createdAt/updatedAt -- is launcher-owned bookkeeping (the sites Map in src/server.js). spec embeds the mixed SiteLaunch schema, and identity (present once state is live) is a real MDK-core Kernel/Worker public-key fingerprint pair written by templates/minimal-site/start.js, only reformatted for display by this launcher.

SiteReveal.description: [MIXED] Field-by-field split: requestCurl is entirely byot (src/server.js's revealCurl(), a reproduction curl string this launcher invents). keys are derived from real MDK-core-generated Kernel/Worker keypairs (templates/minimal-site/start.js's fingerprint()), even though the fingerprint/short display format is byot. storage.corestore points at a real MDK/Hypercore Corestore path (mdk-core primitive, src/server.js's revealStorage()), even though the rest of the storage object's shape (mode/atRest strings) is byot. telemetry reuses sites.overview's real Gateway GET /overview probe (mixed). telemetryStorage, when present, is entirely byot -- the telemetry-store plugin, with no MDK-provided equivalent.

TelemetryStorageMechanism.description: [BYOT] Describes this launcher's own telemetry-store plugin's persistence mechanism (templates/minimal-site/plugins/telemetry-store/lib/store.js); MDK core provides no telemetry-persistence mechanism of its own. Which on-disk mechanism telemetry-store used. Only 'csv' today, kept as an enum (not a boolean) so a future 'sqlite' implementation is additive.

TelemetryStorageGrowth.description: [BYOT] Derived entirely from this launcher's own telemetry-store plugin's CSV file stats (templates/minimal-site/plugins/telemetry-store/controllers/stats.js); no MDK-core equivalent.

bytesPerHour.description: sizeBytes / hours elapsed between the first and most recent recorded sample. null until at least two distinct sample timestamps have been observed.

bytesPerSample.description: sizeBytes / rowCount. null until at least one row has been appended.

path.description: Absolute path to the CSV file on this site's .mdk-data root.

SiteRevealTelemetryStorage.description: [BYOT] Reports on this launcher's own telemetry-store plugin (templates/minimal-site/plugins/telemetry-store), sourced via src/supervisor.js's probeTelemetryStoreStats() hitting that plugin's GET /telemetry-store/stats route; MDK core has no telemetry-persistence mechanism of its own to report on. Optional sibling of SiteReveal.storage/telemetry. Present only when this site's spec.plugins included 'telemetry-store'; otherwise omitted entirely (not null) -- a site that never opted in has nothing to report here.

SiteNotes.description: [BYOT] Pure launcher feature: free-text notes stored on the in-memory site record and rendered into the downloadable spec.yaml (src/server.js, src/spec-yaml.js); no MDK equivalent.
